findings.title: Evidence selection does not persist in the URL or survive refresh
findings.contract: 10_UI_UX_DESIGN.md section 2 requires direct URLs and restored selection; C23 route/selection operation contract
findings.reproduction: Open real API evidence A using ?focus=A; select real evidence B; URL still points to A. Reload and authenticate again: A is displayed, so copied/refreshed URL does not identify the selected evidence.
findings.expected: List selection and search-result positioning update focus; initial navigation, same-path query change and browser Back/Forward restore the corresponding item.

findings.title: Important state and auxiliary text are below the specified font minimums
findings.contract: 10_UI_UX_DESIGN.md section 3: auxiliary text at least 12px and important state at least 13px; C24 unified visual readability
findings.reproduction: Computed styles in Chromium: preview validity/SIMULATED/UNVERIFIED tags 11px, stage accepted/planned count 11px, sidebar label/stage ordinal 11px, mobile bottom navigation 10px. Row tag specificity sometimes yields 12px, still below important-state minimum.
findings.expected: Important state/count labels >=13px, auxiliary labels >=12px, with small/mobile/zoom layout still usable.

findings.title: A stalled normal request never reaches an explanatory timeout or retry state
findings.contract: 10_UI_UX_DESIGN.md section 5 explicitly requires timeout to become an explanatory error rather than indefinite loading; C23 state/error recovery
findings.reproduction: Hold getBudgetPolicy response in Playwright while other real HTTP operations work. At 35 seconds loading remains visible and main error/retry count is zero. Static trace confirms ordinary fetch and allSettled have no deadline; this is not a claim that the specification sets a 35-second limit.
findings.expected: Bound ordinary requests with a finite deadline, distinguish deadline from user/navigation abort, retain retry path; SSE must retain long-lived semantics.
